name: metallic-button
title: Metallic Button
description: Button with a WebGL metallic shader rim, hover and press speed ramps, and a click ripple

props.name: viewMode
props.description: Renders the label or a single sparkle icon.

props.name: baseColor
props.description: Dark base the metal sits on.

props.name: sheenColor
props.description: Overlay tint; sets how warm or cold the chrome reads.

props.name: edgeBlur
props.description: Colour transition sharpness: 0 is a hard edge, 1 a smooth gradient.

props.name: flowAngle
props.description: Direction the pattern flows, in degrees.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Zoom into the pattern; higher reads as brighter chrome.

props.name: warp
props.description: Noise warp over the stripe pattern.

props.name: redFringe
props.description: Red-channel dispersion; drives the warm edge fringing.

props.name: blueFringe
props.description: Blue-channel dispersion; drives the cool edge fringing.

props.name: clickSpeed
props.description: Sweep speed kicked on click, before settling back.
